facts.claim: Very good cows are reared in Bangalore, where they sell for from Rs. 40 to 80 apiece.
facts.quote: Very good cows are reared in Bangalore, where they sell for from Rs. 40 to 80 apiece.

facts.claim: Cattle-shows were held for some years by Government, at which liberal prizes were given, with the view of promoting an improvement in the breed of domestic cattle.
facts.quote: Cattle-shows were held for some years by Government, at which liberal prizes were given, with the view of promoting an improvement in the breed of domestic cattle.

facts.claim: The quality of the mutton sold in Bangalore has been greatly improved by means of prizes offered by the Municipality at the new market.
